name: Clauseway
site_type: One-page SaaS site with a live contract-scan hero, product tabs and scroll-driven sections
features: one-page site: hero, product tabs, how it works, playbooks, security, FAQ, demo form
hero where a contract is scanned: a beam reads down the page, clauses are flagged as it passes, comment cards attach on drawn lines (loops every 10 seconds)
four product tabs (Review, Redline, Compare, Approve) that each play their own scene and cycle by themselves
scroll-driven how-it-works: a document is dropped in, scanned and turned into a summary
playbook section: rules draw lines to the clauses they matched
dark security section where a document folds into a sealed lock as you scroll
all contract text, comments, steps and rules edited in block sidebars
FAQ with WordPress's own Details block: keyboard and no-JavaScript friendly
demo-only email form: nothing is sent and the form says so
six small custom blocks in a plugin, everything else native blocks
self-hosted fonts (Inter Tight, Inter), no third-party scripts
reduced motion shows the finished states; without JavaScript every block shows its finished state
block theme, native blocks, block patterns, no page builder
